questions.exp: Series of perfect squares: 2²,3²,4²,5²,6²=36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If BLACK is coded as YOZVP (reverse alphabet, A=Z, B=Y...), how is WHITE coded?
questions.exp: Reverse alphabet: A=Z,B=Y...so W=D,H=S,I=R,T=G,E=V. WHITE=DSRGV.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A person walks 5km East, then 12km North. Find the distance from the starting point.
questions.exp: Using Pythagoras (5-12-13 triplet): distance=√(5²+12²)=√(25+144)=√169=13km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 35 students, Rahul is 14th from the right. What is his position from the left?
questions.exp: Position from left = Total+1-Position from right = 36-14 = 22nd.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: 16, 25, 36, 48, 64
questions.exp: 16,25,36,64 are perfect squares (4²,5²,6²,8²). 48 is not a perfect square — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Ram is taller than Shyam but shorter than Mohan. Sohan is taller than Mohan. Who is the tallest?
questions.exp: Height order: Sohan>Mohan>Ram>Shyam. Sohan is the tallest.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: AZ, CY, EX, GW, ?
questions.exp: First letters skip one going forward (A,C,E,G,I) and second letters skip one going backward (Z,Y,X,W,V). Answer=IV.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Cow, Buffalo, Goat, Tiger
questions.exp: Cow, Buffalo, and Goat are domesticated herbivorous animals. Tiger is a wild carnivorous animal — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is the sister of B. B is the son of C. D is the husband of C. How is A related to D?
questions.exp: B is C's son and D is C's husband, so D is B's father. A is B's sister, so A is also D's daughter.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 30 people, M is 12th from the left and N is 10th from the right. How many people are between M and N?
questions.exp: N's position from left=30-10+1=21. People between M(12th) and N(21st)=21-12-1=8.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: Z25, X23, V21, T19, ?
questions.exp: Letters go backward by 2 (Z,X,V,T,R) and numbers decrease by 2 (25,23,21,19,17). Answer=R17.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 17 days?
questions.exp: 17 days = 2 weeks (14 days) + 3 days. Wednesday + 3 days = Saturday.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a row. P is to the left of Q but right of R. S is to the right of T but left of R. What is the order from left to right?
questions.exp: From clues: T-S-R-P-Q satisfies all conditions: P is left of Q (true), P is right of R (true), S is right of T (true), S is left of R (true).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Complete the series: C4, F8, I16, L32, ?
questions.exp: Letters skip 2 (C,F,I,L,O) and numbers double (4,8,16,32,64). Answer=O64.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is twice as old as B. Five years ago, A was three times as old as B. Find B's current age.
questions.exp: Let B=x, A=2x. Five years ago: 2x-5=3(x-5). 2x-5=3x-15. x=10. B's age=10 years.
